title: Tamarind-Glazed Pork Chops

ingredientGroups.title: Dry rub (per lb)
items: 1 tsp olive oil, or enough to coat
¼ tsp cumin, crushed almost to a powder

steps: Combine the brine ingredients in a medium bowl or large ziplock bag.
Trim the pork chops and place in the brine for 45-60 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine all the glaze ingredients in a small pot and simmer over low heat until the minced chili is soft and the mixture resembles a pourable jam, approximately 8 minutes.
Remove the pork chops from the brine and pat dry.
Apply a light coat of olive oil to the pork chops and then evenly dust both sides with the dry rub mixture.
Sear the exterior over medium-high until golden brown.  Don’t forget to also sear the fat strip along the sides.  Don’t worry about the interior temperature because it will be finished in the oven.
Transfer to a foil lined sheet, preferably elevated on a wire rack.
Let the meat cool for 30-60 seconds then brush both sides with the glaze.
Bake in the oven until the thickest part of the pork chop measures 135 F, approximately 4-6 minutes.  Flip once during the baking process so that both sides caramelize evenly.
Remove from the oven and rest for 4 minutes to reabsorb the juices.
Plate with a small smear of the leftover glaze.
